metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Gobi Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Collection: MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) - use `MODIS/006/MYD04_L2` (Aqua) or `MODIS/006/MOD04_L2` (Terra) - Dates: February 2019 and February 2020 - Location: Gobi Desert (roughly 40-45°N, 100-120°E) - Extract AOD band (typically 'Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um' or similar 550nm band) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - MODIS AOD data has quality flags. Filter by QA flag to use only high-quality retrievals - No cloud masking needed as AOD is already retrieved over clouds/land - Check pixel counts to detect data availability issues 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid AOD ranges: 0 to ~5 (typical range -0.1 to 4) - If mean AOD is `None`, `NaN`, or outside physical range → C3 - If pixel count is 0 after QA filtering → C2 - If collection size is 0 → C1 (try recovery with alternative collection) - Compare mean AOD Feb2020 vs Feb2019: if Feb2020 > Feb2019 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Gobi Desert boundary (approximate) const gobiBoundary = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([100, 40, 120, 45]); // February 2019 const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD04_L2') .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01') .filterBounds(gobiBoundary); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data for Feb 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } // February 2020 const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD04_L2') .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-03-01') .filterBounds(gobiBoundary); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2020 === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data for Feb 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Composite and extract AOD (Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um = 550nm equivalent) const mean2019 = col2019 .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .mean() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: gobiBoundary, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .getInfo(); const count2019 = col2019 .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .mean() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: gobiBoundary, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .getInfo(); console.log(`2019 AOD: ${mean2019 !== null ? (mean2019 * 0.001).toFixed(3) : 'null'} (pixels: ${count2019})`); const mean2020 = col2020 .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .mean() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: gobiBoundary, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .getInfo(); const count2020 = col2020 .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .mean() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: gobiBoundary, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('Optical_Depth_Land_2p1um') .getInfo(); console.log(`2020 AOD: ${mean2020 !== null ? (mean2020 * 0.001).toFixed(3) : 'null'} (pixels: ${count2020})`); // Validation if (mean2019 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2020)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Scale from int16 (raw) to actual AOD (divide by 1000) const aod2019 = mean2019 * 0.001; const aod2020 = mean2020 * 0.001; // Check physical validity if (aod2019 < -0.5 || aod2019 > 5 || aod2020 < -0.5 || aod2020 > 5) { console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Comparison: 2020 (${aod2020.toFixed(3)}) vs 2019 (${aod2019.toFixed(3)})`); if (aod2020 > aod2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
